tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy single-column run (GNU gfortran 13.3 REAL*4 build, dt = 60 s; data/eqwefic/scm_dyn) dumped by the ctessum-claude/WRF fork, branch earthsciml-instrumented, commit 83347b2 (rk_tendency, rk_step 1), merged with the same step's radiation subassembly dump and the wrfout eta grid (tools/merge_dumps.py -> data/eqwefic/dumps/dyn_column/esm_dump_dyn_suite_<step>.json). Expected values are the sums of the dumped mass-coupled increments of perturbation_coriolis, curvature, rk_rayleigh_damp and pg_buoy_w divided by the coupling mass of their grid point. Every mounted component receives the SAME dumped state; the geometry-derived inputs of the other four (interface heights, eta interpolation weights, perturbation pressure) come from the coupled WRFColumnGeometry, not from the dump. Measured residual (zero tolerance): Linf 1.2e-10 m/s^2 in du_dt (values <= 4.3e-4), 2.1e-11 in dv_dt, 3.3e-11 in dw_dt_nonpg, 3.1e-11 K/s in dtheta_m_dt, 0.016 Pa in p_p, rel 2.7e-8 in du_dt[1] and 1.5e-7 in dtheta_m_dt[59] -- identical to the standalone component tests, so the coupled geometry path adds nothing (its z_w agrees with WRF's z_at_w to 1.3e-7, its weights with fnm/fnp to 1.5e-8). Tolerances 5-10x above. The TOTAL w tendency is the exception: Linf 3.0e-4 m/s^2 against a profile maximum of 4.7e-4 (RMS 1.7e-4). That residual is the reference's, not the model's: WRF evaluates the equation of state in single precision, so its perturbation pressure p' carries 1.2-1.6e-2 Pa of rounding (the p_p assertion), and the vertical pressure-gradient term differentiates p' over a layer-centre spacing of ~0.0076 in eta, amplifying that rounding by g/(mu_d deta) ~ 0.016 m/s^2/Pa into a spurious w tendency of the same size as the physical one. Fed WRF's own dumped p', the same vertical-momentum component reproduces pg_buoy_w to 6.0e-9 m/s^2 (couplings-free test in components/atmospheric_dynamics/wrf_arw/vertical_momentum.esm). The total is therefore bounded only at abs 1e-3 m/s^2, which still fails any structural error (dropping mu' moves it by 1.2e-2, the moisture loading by 2.5e-2). Regime: step 1410 (t = 23.5 h after 1999-10-22 19:00 UTC, late morning of the second day).

input_q_t.expr: rad_qv + rad_qc + rad_qr + rad_qi + rad_qs + rad_qg
